checked_claims.note: Attempt target block is byte-identical to TASK.json and to the packet JSON; packet_sha256 matches the task. Independently recomputed: d=3*5-3+8=20; PD for a smooth DM stack with Q-coefficients gives H^BM_16 = H^{2d-16}(20) = H^24(20); Q(20) has weight -40 so weight 24-40=-16 matches open_bm_weight; Q(-12)(20)=Q(8) matches open_bm_tate_type; codim 12 = d-8 matches RED-0001's Q(-(d-8)). No twist or degree slip found.
n=8>=2 and 2g-2+n=10-2+8=16=k, so THM-0004 puts (5,8) exactly at the extremal open-stratum base case. Cross-check: every n>=2 entry of RED-0001 satisfies 2g-2+n=16, i.e. 2g+n=18.

Duality bookkeeping is correct (see target-dictionary). Caveat: the attempt never records the consequence that W_24 H^24(M_{5,8}) is the LOWEST-weight piece of H^24, i.e. the image of H^24(Mbar_{5,8};Q) -> H^24(M_{5,8};Q) (weights of H^k of a smooth variety lie in [k,2k]). That identification is what actually constrains the group and is unused.
c(5)=7 < 8, so THM-0005 does not cover M_{5,8}. The attempt correctly declines to claim CKgP, algebraicity, or tautological generation at n=8, consistent with the execution boundary.

Three independent defects. (i) Vacuity at the target degree: fibers of f are affine curves so E_2^{p,q}=0 for q>=2, and Harer's vcd(M_{g,n})=4g-4+n gives vcd(M_{5,7})=23, hence E_2^{24,0}=H^24(M_{5,7},R^0 f_*Q)=0 and (no differentials can reach or leave E_2^{23,1}) H^24(M_{5,8}) = H^23(M_{5,7},R^1 f_*Q) in full; the 'pure Tate base tensor pure Tate fiber' contribution A4 controls is the zero group, so nothing is isolated. (ii) Category error: H^1 of a genus-5 curve minus 7 points is a non-split weight extension 0 -> H^1(C) -> H^1(C\S) -> ker(Q(-1)^7 -> Q(-1)) -> 0, so R^1 f_*Q is not a direct sum of a Tate part and a symplectic part and 'tensored with pure Tate fiber cohomology' presumes an unavailable splitting. (iii) Range/object slip: THM-0005 + SRC-0002 Prop 4.5 is a CKgP/tautological-Chow statement yielding algebraicity of pure-weight cohomology of the compactified moduli inside the induction-controlled range; A4 uses it as Tate-ness of the pure-weight cohomology of the OPEN M_{5,7} in unbounded degree (up to 23). Status must be downgraded from 'proved'.

Geometric inputs check out: the trigonal locus in M_5 has dimension 2g+1=11=dim M_5 - 1 (a divisor), non-trigonal genus-5 canonical curves are (2,2,2) complete intersections in P^4, and the g^1_3 is unique for g>=5 so mark-incidence refinement is well posed. But the target is a lowest-weight graded piece = image from a smooth compactification; that is not stratum-local, so no stratification weight spectral sequence computes it without global differential information. G3 concedes no page was evaluated.

The trace formula sees only the virtual (alternating) Frobenius trace on H^*_c, so removing 'other weight-graded pieces that can contribute to the same monomial degree' is not sufficient: a non-Tate summand of weight 16 sitting in odd-degree H^*_c cancels against Tate contributions of the same absolute value, and polynomiality of the count over all F_{q^m} constrains only the virtual motive, never a single (degree, weight) multiplicity. Separately, a plain automorphism-weighted count of M_{5,8}(F_q) yields the character at the identity of S_8 only; genuinely S_8-equivariant information needs counts of twisted forms, which is never stated. The dualization H^BM_16 = (H^16_c)^dual is also never performed, so the monomial the target would contribute (q^8, from the top-weight piece gr^W_16 H^16_c of type Q(-8)) is left unpinned.

Honest: monodromy/Ext control on M_{5,7} is neither cited nor proved. Note it is also the wrong target after defect (i) above, since the whole group lives in E^{23,1}, not just an 'obstruction part' of it.

The Tate-type statement for the open input is not established and no non-Tate summand is exhibited. Consistent with OBS-0001 and with CONJ-0001 remaining conjectural; the attempt does not use CONJ-0001 or RED-0001 (truth status 'inferred') as a theorem anywhere in a load-bearing step.

Stack-vs-coarse is handled correctly: with Q-coefficients H^*(stack)=H^*(coarse) and automorphism-weighted counts compute the stacky H^*_c, so the 'irreducible as a coarse geometric object' aside is harmless. No integral-coefficient claim is made anywhere, so no Z/Q conflation. The Betti/etale/motivic comparison assumption is flagged rather than used to smuggle a semisimplification into a Hodge-structure isomorphism, and G4 explicitly refuses semisimplification and arithmetic prediction as completeness certificates.

finding_candidates.statement: For every RED-0001 entry with n>=2 the extremality k=2g-2+n=16 forces 2g+n=18, hence the ordinary realization degree 2d-16=6g+2n-22 equals Harer's vcd(M_{g,n})=4g-4+n exactly: (3,12)->20, (5,8)->24, (6,6)->26, (7,4)->28, (8,2)->30; the n=0,1 entries (8,0)->26 and (8,1)->28 sit at vcd-1. The open input is therefore top-degree (or next-to-top-degree) rational cohomology of the open moduli, well above its complex dimension. If the known vanishing of H^{vcd}(M_{g,n};Q) for g>=2 applies, the open input is zero, hence trivially a (empty) direct sum of Q(8), and the entire point-count/monodromy program is unnecessary. The vcd input is reviewer-supplied and outside the dependency-closed corpus; this must be corroborated against a citable source before use.

The forgetful fibration f:M_{g,n}->M_{g,n-1} cannot isolate the degree-16 open input in the RED-0001 base cases: fibers are affine curves so the Leray page is concentrated in q<=1, and vcd(M_{g,n-1})=4g-5+n=(2d-16)-1 kills the q=0 column in the target degree, so H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n}) equals H^{2d-17}(M_{g,n-1},R^1f_*Q) with no room for differentials. Any argument of the form 'pure Tate base tensor pure Tate fiber gives pure Tate' controls the zero group and yields no progress.

Reductions that split R^1f_*Q for a punctured-curve fibration into 'symplectic part plus Tate part' are invalid: H^1(C minus {p_1..p_m}) is a non-split extension of ker(Q(-1)^m -> Q(-1)) by H^1(C), so tensor-decomposition language on the Leray page presumes a splitting that does not exist as a variation of mixed Hodge structure. Purity of a graded piece must be argued through the extension, not around it.

THM-0005 together with SRC-0002 Prop 4.5 licenses algebraicity of pure-weight cohomology of the compactified moduli within the range the low-homology induction controls. It does not license 'the open M_{g,n} with n<=c(g) has pure Tate cohomology in all degrees'. Any step that uses a CKgP marking bound as a blanket Tate-ness statement about an open moduli space, or in unbounded degree, is a silent upgrade of pure Tate to algebraic/tautological generation and violates the execution boundary.

Point counts over F_q determine only the virtual Frobenius trace on H^*_c, so no count - however exact, and even if polynomial over all F_{q^m} - pins the multiplicity of a Tate class in one prescribed (degree, weight) pair. Removing 'other weight-graded pieces of the same monomial degree' is insufficient because non-Tate summands of the same weight in odd-degree H^*_c cancel against Tate summands of the same absolute value. Genuine S_n-isotypic information additionally requires counts of twisted forms, not automorphism-weighted counts of M_{g,n}(F_q). A completed exact count is therefore necessary but not sufficient for a Tate-type conclusion, and a point-count approach needs an independent parity/degree-separation input.

Before any arithmetic argument, the Borel-Moore target must be dualized explicitly: H^BM_16(X) = (H^16_c(X))^dual for X smooth, so the group is gr^W_16 H^16_c(M_{g,n}) of Tate type Q(-8), contributing +q^8 to the count; equivalently, on the ordinary side W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n}) is the LOWEST-weight piece, i.e. the image of H^{2d-16} of a smooth compactification. Skipping this step leaves the expected Frobenius monomial unpinned and invites conflating gr^W_16 H^16_c(M_{g,n}) with the packet's compact target H^16(Mbar_{g,n}), which is a different group that also carries type Q(-8).

strongest_attack: Strongest attack: the only claim in the attempt that is both marked 'proved' and does real work, A4's 'structural positive statement' about the forgetful fibration f:M_{5,8}->M_{5,7}, is simultaneously vacuous and unjustified. Vacuous because the fibers are affine curves (E_2^{p,q}=0 for q>=2) and Harer's vcd(M_{5,7})=4g-4+n=23 forces E_2^{24,0}=0, so with no differentials available H^24(M_{5,8}) equals H^23(M_{5,7},R^1f_*Q) entirely: the 'pure Tate base tensor pure Tate fiber' summand A4 certifies is the zero group and the claimed confinement of the obstruction to the monodromy-nontrivial part is a restatement of the target, not a reduction. Unjustified because it presumes R^1f_*Q splits off its Tate part (it is a non-split weight extension of Q(-1)^6 by the weight-1 symplectic system) and because it upgrades packet THM-0005/Prop 4.5 - a CKgP/tautological-Chow statement about the compactified moduli within the induction-controlled range - into Tate-ness of the pure-weight cohomology of the OPEN M_{5,7} in every degree. Outcome: the attack lands but does not change the verdict; A4's status should be downgraded from 'proved' to 'partial', and A6's stated equality is false as written (trace formula gives only virtual traces). Runner-up attack, and the one that could reverse the framing rather than the verdict: the extremality 16=2g-2+n forces 2g+n=18, hence ordinary degree 2d-16=6g+2n-22=4g-4+n=vcd(M_{g,n}) exactly for every n>=2 entry of RED-0001, so the open input is top-degree rational cohomology of M_{g,n} and known vcd-degree vanishing results would make it zero - trivially Tate - and the (5,8) 'obstruction' vacuous. That relies on a theorem outside the closed corpus and is filed as a candidate needing corroboration, not asserted.
